description: Partially update a product or charge (only provided fields change). A charge's due_date, recurrence and late fees are editable here; `kind` is not — it is fixed at creation. Requires scope `merchant_write`.

amount.description: Amount in BRL cents (R$5.00–R$6000.00). Wire field is `amount`.

amount_cents.description: Alias of `amount` (BRL cents). Provide either `amount` or `amount_cents`.

due_date.description: REQUIRED when kind is `charge`. First due date, YYYY-MM-DD, and the anchor of the recurrence. May be in the past — a retroactive charge starts already overdue.

late_fine_bps.description: Charges only. One-time late fine in basis points of the base amount (200 = 2%). Default 0, max 2000 (20%).

late_interest_monthly_bps.description: Charges only. Monthly interest in basis points, accrued pro-rata per day late (100 = 1% a month). Default 0, max 1000 (10%).

recurrence.description: Charges only. null or omitted = a one-time charge. Monthly and above anchor on the due day, clamping to the last day of shorter months (the 31st becomes Feb 28/29).

name: update_product
title: Update product
